spec.name: sprint33_predmkt_crossvenue_spread_monitor
spec.hypothesis: Kalshi and Polymarket price economically-identical event contracts with measurable, exploitable spreads net of fees; settlement-definition mismatch (not spread existence) is the main threat to tradeability.
spec.power_argument: This is a measurement phase, not a powered trade backtest — no t-stat criterion applies yet (forcing one would violate the exp14 no-can't-fail rule on data we don't have). Falsifiable gate for phase 2: if <300 spread-observations/week clear (venue spread net of both fee schedules) AND pass manual settlement-text matching over a 14-day monitoring window, door closes as sub-scale; else proceeds to a powered paper-backtest spec with same 300-trade/t=2 standard.
spec.symbols: N/A — event-contract pairs matched by resolution-criteria text, not tickers
spec.fee_tier: new tier required — Kalshi/Polymarket fee schedules not yet in cost model, must be registered before phase 2
spec.entry_per_day_cap: N/A this phase; max concurrently monitored pairs = 25
